_about: item 10 — every Foreign Languages row, its language by the June split's classifier (TOP 11xx -> title -> local subject), and the code it takes

Korean.basis: ruled: keeps the CSR code, flagged

Greek.basis: flagged: no dominant four-letter local code, keeps the CSR code

Hebrew.basis: flagged: no dominant four-letter local code, keeps the CSR code

Hindi.basis: dominant local code is four letters (thin: 3 rows)

Hmong.basis: flagged: no dominant four-letter local code, keeps the CSR code

Latin.basis: dominant local code is four letters

Nahuatl.basis: flagged: dominant local code SPAN belongs to another language, keeps the CSR code

Persian.basis: flagged: the local codes tie (PRSN and PERSIN), keeps the CSR code

Punjabi.basis: flagged: no dominant four-letter local code, keeps the CSR code

Tagalog.basis: flagged: no dominant four-letter local code, keeps the CSR code
